versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- No changes were made to core skill functionality or documentation.

- Initial release of the 大都会博物馆 (“the-met”) skill.
- Enables search and retrieval of open collection data from the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
- Requires user to provide an API key before use; prompts if missing.
- Supports listing museum departments, searching objects, and viewing detailed object information.
- Enforces workflow for user interaction, parameter extraction, and API calling.
- Prohibits data generation or search without a valid API key.
